servinfo.title: Guide Me Light System Description (If Equipped)
servinfo.ptxt: Guide me light system functions to illuminate the road at night turning on the clearance light, headlight, tail light and license plate light for specified time when the driver gets off or gets on the vehicle.

servinfosub.title: Guide Me Light to Home
servinfosub.ptxt: When passing light switch is operated to ON while lighting switch is positioned in “AUTO”, the clearance light, headlight, tail light and license plate light turn on for specified time under the following conditions.

item.ptxt: Guide me light to home function: Not in operation

servinfosub.ptxt: The lights go out if any one of the following conditions is met.

item.ptxt: Lighting switch: Detects position change to other than “AUTO”

servinfosub.title: Guide Me Light to Car
servinfosub.ptxt: When unlocking the doors using remote controller / transmitter while lighting switch is positioned in “AUTO”, the clearance light, headlight, tail light and license plate light turn on for a specified time under the following conditions.
The lights go out if any one of the following conditions is met.

item.ptxt: Doors are locked with key cylinder, remote controller or transmitter
Lighting switch: Detects position change to other than “AUTO”
